steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with one vendor bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Keep counter-offer controls available on RFQ rounds as required.
Use the configured live-bidding behavior for bid controls.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Apply the required counter-offer percentage configuration.
Capture the event's live state before opening withdrawal.
Verify the existing bidder is present before cancellation.
Verify the existing bid price before cancellation.
Reach the Responses view specified by the case.
Open the RFQ withdrawal dialog without confirming withdrawal.
Cancel the withdrawal so the dialog should close without changing the event.
Assert that the Withdrawing Order dialog closed.
Assert that the event remains live after cancellation.
Verify the bidder remains unchanged after cancellation.
Verify the existing bid price remains unchanged after cancellation.
